final: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(e."aCL IgM") as overall_mean FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL), exam_deviations AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e."aCL IgM", os.overall_mean, (e."aCL IgM" - os.overall_mean) as deviation FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL), sex_avg_deviations AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) as avg_dev FROM exam_deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT ed.ID, ed.SEX, ed."aCL IgM", ed.deviation, (ed.deviation - sad.avg_dev) as exceeds_by FROM exam_deviations ed LEFT JOIN sex_avg_deviations sad ON ed.SEX = sad.SEX WHERE ed.deviation > sad.avg_dev ORDER BY exceeds_by DESC, ed.SEX DESC LIMIT 10
